name: Qin
desc: Esteems law and the military; the court is tightly ordered, and mortal rule is as hard as iron.

name: Jin
desc: Great clans stand in solemn ranks; the gentry delight in lofty discourse, and court and countryside prize ritual and reputation.

name: Song
desc: Values letters over arms; its institutions are dense and refined, and private academies flourish among the people.

name: Liang
desc: The court is elegant and polished, the scholarly mood ornate, and its governance inclusive yet full of subtle maneuvering.

name: Chu
desc: Its lands are broad and customs varied; shamanic airs still linger, and powerful local houses rise along the frontier.

name: Qi
desc: Rich in trade and craft, open to the sea, with a court adept at gathering revenue and directing resources.

name: Yan
desc: The northern land is bitterly cold; it honors martial defense, and the court carries a steady, austere character.

name: Zhao
desc: Horsemanship and archery are common custom; military and civil rule stand side by side, and the border spirit runs deep.

name: Wei
desc: Its laws are clear and exacting, sovereign authority is strong, and the hundred offices move with rare efficiency.

name: Han
desc: Though not outwardly overbearing, the dynasty values practical affairs and careful governance at the local level.

name: Wu
desc: Rivers and waterways crisscross the realm, merchants travel often, and the court is skilled at using the advantage of boats and transport.

name: Yue
desc: Its mountains and marshes run deep, the people are tenacious, and the court excels at holding fast before striking.
